summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd (NYSE: LUD) filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, announcing a signed memorandum of understanding to acquire 55% of Asia AI Data Centre Quantum Technology Company Limited from Ms. Liu Liangping, who is COO of Luda and spouse of CEO Ma Biu. Consideration is USD400,000 cash plus USD535,000 in ordinary shares. The transaction marks entry into data centre and AI computing infrastructure. Ms. Liu resigned as Luda director on June 18, 2026. The deal is related-party, requiring scrutiny of independent board approvals. No premium or closing date disclosed. Watch for definitive agreement execution, regulatory clearance, and potential conflicts of interest given overlapping management.
